title: seen_jobs
description: Record of the postings /job-scrape has seen, for dedup across runs. Source of truth ONLY for pre-note triage; the pipeline status lives in the frontmatter of the notes in 03-Applications/ of the career workspace, and the dashboard is a derived view.

schema_version.description: 2 = English field names. A version 1 file is migrated with career-registry's scripts/migrate_workspace.py

updated.description: ISO date of the last write

jobs.description: Map job_key -> entry. job_key = 'slug(company)|slug(title)', computed with scripts/job_key.py (rules in references/dedup-playbook.md).

title.description: Title as it was first seen

source_id.description: Native ID at the source (LinkedIn numeric, GetOnBoard slug)

first_seen.description: First time seen at any source

profile.description: Profile note it was scored against (name of the note in 01-Profiles/)

quick_score.description: Cheap triage on the listing data

match_score.description: Score from the full job-search rubric, if it ran

status.description: Triage states. There is deliberately NO 'applied': once the note is created the entry freezes and the pipeline continues in the note's frontmatter (moved by /job-outcome).

note.description: File name of the note in 03-Applications/ (required when status=note_created, see allOf)

salary_max_usd_month.description: Highest published salary in USD/month, to re-triage without re-fetching
